definitions.explanation: Unpolished rice with the bran layer intact, more nutritious than white rice but with a chewier texture and nuttier flavor.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{玄米|げんまい}を{食|た}べている。
examples.english: I eat brown rice for my health.

examples.japanese: {玄米|げんまい}は{白米|はくまい}より{栄養|えいよう}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: Brown rice is more nutritious than white rice.

examples.japanese: {玄米|げんまい}ご{飯|はん}を{炊|た}く。

notes:
USAGE:
{玄米|げんまい} is rice that has only had its husk removed, retaining the bran ({糠|ぬか}) and germ. It requires longer cooking time and more water than white rice.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{玄米|げんまい}ご{飯|はん} (cooked brown rice)
・{玄米|げんまい}を{炊|た}く (cook brown rice)
・{玄米|げんまい}{食|しょく} (brown rice diet)

RELATED TERMS:
・{発芽|はつが}{玄米|げんまい} (germinated brown rice - GABA rice)
・{精米|せいまい} (rice polishing)
・{分|ぶ}づき{米|まい} (partially polished rice)
